description: This file defines a React functional component 'EditGuardrailForm' used for editing guardrail configurations in a user interface. It manages form inputs, fetches guardrail settings, handles provider-specific configurations, and submits updates via API calls. The component supports multiple guardrail providers and integrates PII configuration UI when needed.

methods.name: handleProviderChange
methods.description: Handles change of guardrail provider, resets provider-specific form fields and internal state.

methods.name: handleEntitySelect
methods.description: Updates selected entities for PII configuration when user selects/deselects entities.

methods.name: handleActionSelect
methods.description: Updates selected action for a specific entity in PII configuration.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Validates form, prepares payload including provider-specific parameters, and submits update request.

methods.name: renderPiiConfiguration
methods.description: Renders PII configuration UI component if provider is PresidioPII.

methods.name: renderProviderSpecificFields
methods.description: Renders form fields tailored to the selected guardrail provider, including JSON configuration inputs.
